Civil Engineer SNR. CIVIL ENGINEER The successful candidate will have primary responsibility to lead the planning, designing construction, and maintenance of civil and structural infrastructure across our Plant and Mining operations. The successful candidate will also provide technical leadership for capital and maintenance projects, ensuring compliance with engineering standards, safety and environmental requirements, and regulatory obligations. Main Responsibilities: Lead the planning, design, execution, and maintenance of civil and structural projects across Plant and Mining operations. Develop and review engineering designs in compliance with company standards, industry best practices, and regulatory requirements. Prepare engineering drawings, specifications, BOQs, cost estimates, procurement documents, and technical reports. Manage capital and maintenance projects to ensure delivery within scope, budget, schedule, and quality standards. Oversee contractors, consultants, and construction activities to ensure compliance with engineering, safety, environmental, and statutory requirements. Conduct site inspections and structural assessments, recommending repairs, upgrades, and infrastructure improvements as needed. Resolve engineering and construction issues through practical, cost-effective solutions. Monitor project performance and provide progress, cost, and risk reports to management. Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to support successful project delivery. Ensure compliance with health, safety, environmental, and quality management standards. Provide technical leadership and mentorship while driving continuous improvement, operational reliability, and asset performance. Required Competencies: Strong knowledge of civil and structural engineering principles, standards, codes, and regulatory requirements. Proven project management, budgeting, and contractor management experience. Ability to interpret and prepare engineering drawings, specifications, and construction documents. Proficiency in AutoCAD, Microsoft Office Suite, and other engineering software applications. Experience preparing Bills of Quantities (BOQs), cost estimates, and procurement documentation. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Excellent technical report writing, presentation, and communication skills. Demonstrated leadership and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders. Qualifications and Experience: A Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering/Construction Management 5 – 8 years of progressive civil engineering experience. Ref: Snr. Civil Engineer Apply Now
